sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (ö) /ø/. It makes the sound /ø/, as in the word (öt) /øt/, which means five. This letter has only one sound in Hungarian.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Shape your lips into a tight circle. Keep your tongue pushed forward, near your lower teeth. Let your voice buzz smoothly. Touch your throat to feel the strong vibration.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /ø/ wherever it appears. For example, you hear it in the word (kör) /kør/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say the sound in the English word bird. Round your lips firmly, and push your tongue forward.
